role_assignments_dates.name: role_assignments_dates
role_assignments_dates.value: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from

users_has_login.name: users_has_login
users_has_login.value: login_phone IS NOT NULL OR login_email IS NOT NULL

attendance_corrections_times_order.name: attendance_corrections_times_order
attendance_corrections_times_order.value: requested_in IS NULL OR requested_out IS NULL OR requested_in < requested_out

attendance_corrections_not_own_decision.name: attendance_corrections_not_own_decision
attendance_corrections_not_own_decision.value: decided_by IS NULL OR (decided_by <> person_id AND decided_by <> requested_by)

attendance_corrections_not_own_approver.name: attendance_corrections_not_own_approver
attendance_corrections_not_own_approver.value: approver_person_id IS NULL OR (approver_person_id <> person_id AND approver_person_id <> requested_by)

attendance_corrections_rejected_has_reas.name: attendance_corrections_rejected_has_reason
attendance_corrections_rejected_has_reas.value: status <> 'rejected' OR decision_reason IS NOT NULL

attendance_events_location_status_check.name: attendance_events_location_status_check
attendance_events_location_status_check.value: location_status IS NULL OR location_status IN ('inside','outside','poor_accuracy','not_configured','not_taken')

overtime_requests_not_own_decision.name: overtime_requests_not_own_decision
overtime_requests_not_own_decision.value: decided_by IS NULL OR (decided_by <> person_id AND decided_by <> requested_by)

overtime_requests_not_own_approver.name: overtime_requests_not_own_approver
overtime_requests_not_own_approver.value: approver_person_id IS NULL OR (approver_person_id <> person_id AND approver_person_id <> requested_by)

overtime_requests_rejected_has_reason.name: overtime_requests_rejected_has_reason
overtime_requests_rejected_has_reason.value: status <> 'rejected' OR decision_reason IS NOT NULL

work_days_leave_absent_check.name: work_days_leave_absent_check
work_days_leave_absent_check.value: leave_days IN (0, 0.5, 1) AND absent_days IN (0, 0.5, 1) AND leave_days + absent_days <= 1

work_days_extra_check.name: work_days_extra_check
work_days_extra_check.value: extra_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND worked_minutes AND approved_overtime_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND extra_minutes

weekly_off_rules_dates.name: weekly_off_rules_dates
weekly_off_rules_dates.value: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from

expense_claims_not_self_approved.name: expense_claims_not_self_approved
expense_claims_not_self_approved.value: approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> person_id

expense_claims_not_self_rejected.name: expense_claims_not_self_rejected
expense_claims_not_self_rejected.value: rejected_by IS NULL OR rejected_by <> person_id

expense_claims_approved_within_claim.name: expense_claims_approved_within_claim
expense_claims_approved_within_claim.value: approved_amount_paise IS NULL OR (approved_amount_paise > 0 AND approved_amount_paise <= amount_paise)

expense_claims_paid_has_details.name: expense_claims_paid_has_details
expense_claims_paid_has_details.value: status <> 'paid' OR (paid_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_ref IS NOT NULL)

expense_claims_rejected_has_reason.name: expense_claims_rejected_has_reason
expense_claims_rejected_has_reason.value: status <> 'rejected' OR rejection_reason IS NOT NULL

leave_ledger_reason_required.name: leave_ledger_reason_required
leave_ledger_reason_required.value: entry NOT IN ('opening','adjustment','grant') OR reason IS NOT NULL

leave_requests_not_own_decision.name: leave_requests_not_own_decision
leave_requests_not_own_decision.value: decided_by IS NULL OR decided_by <> person_id

leave_requests_not_own_approver.name: leave_requests_not_own_approver
leave_requests_not_own_approver.value: approver_person_id IS NULL OR approver_person_id <> person_id

leave_requests_decided_fields.name: leave_requests_decided_fields
leave_requests_decided_fields.value: (status IN ('approved','rejected')) = (decided_by IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL) OR status = 'cancelled'

leave_requests_rejected_has_reason.name: leave_requests_rejected_has_reason
leave_requests_rejected_has_reason.value: status <> 'rejected' OR decision_reason IS NOT NULL

employments_exit_after_join.name: employments_exit_after_join
employments_exit_after_join.value: exit_on IS NULL OR exit_on >= joined_on

employments_exited_has_date_and_reason.name: employments_exited_has_date_and_reason
employments_exited_has_date_and_reason.value: status <> 'exited' OR (exit_on IS NOT NULL AND exit_reason IS NOT NULL)

employments_recruited_before_join.name: employments_recruited_before_join
employments_recruited_before_join.value: recruited_on IS NULL OR recruited_on <= joined_on
